item.title: Clever And Easy Bodybuilding For Ladies
item.description: Discover the three phases of sustainable bodybuilding that blend jogging, dancing, and progressive dumbbell work into a lifetime fitness routine. Learn how to build endurance without stopping, transition from cardio to strength training, and achieve full-body development through gentle, rhythmic movement. This guide reveals why gradual progression, proper weight selection, and integrated body training—not muscle isolation—create the fastest, most effective, and most sustainable path to staying forever young and healthy.

item.title: Yikes!
item.description: A passionate exploration of visual programming's transformative power. The author abandoned all other projects after discovering that visual workflows could accomplish what traditional coding couldn't. In minimal time, they created four powerful command-line tools. The post examines why some problems are simply unsolvable through conventional programming—and how visual programming solved them. It also explores the uncanny intersection of AI-generated content, with eerie animations and the haunting phenomenon of AI-generated blinking that emerges from nowhere.

item.title: What Is The System?
item.description: A searing field manual from someone the system wrote off—exposing how education, debt, and work form a pipeline of controlled poverty, and how the only exit is the one nobody advertised: reading, understanding, and trusting your own mind. Drawing from the hacker ethic and public data, this text breaks down the machine emerged to keep you useful, profitable and quiet, then maps the way out—the one thing the System cannot meter or tax.

item.title: The Visual Programming Twist: No If, Loop, or even Function
item.description: A radical rethinking of visual programming that eliminates traditional constructs like if statements, loops, and explicit functions. Instead, this approach uses sequential data cables and branching based on their order. Discover how complex tools like ffmpeg are abstracted into intuitive visual commands, how deeply nested loops and streams power individual nodes, and how powerful AI-driven functionality can be wrapped in deceptively simple interfaces.

item.title: Did We Just Enter The Golden Era Of Software?
item.description: A manifesto for the next generation of indie software creators: how to build beautiful, profitable desktop applications by combining AI programming with human vision and artistic design. Explore monetization strategies, licensing approaches using public-key cryptography, and why the composer—not just the code—is what customers truly pay for. From stripped-down freemium models to privacy-first firewalls, discover why we're entering the golden era of amazing desktop software, and how your personal vision is the irreplaceable ingredient that AI cannot replicate.

item.title: Bodybuilding For Old People
item.description: A provocative critique of modern gym culture that argues heavy‑lifting with frequent rest and “muscle‑failure” tactics accelerate muscle loss, especially in older adults. The author champions continuous, non‑stop movement—walking with wrist or leg weights, sustained 30‑45‑minute sessions, and gradual weight increments—as the most effective way for seniors to preserve and rebuild muscle, contrasting this approach with the intermittent, rest‑heavy routines popular among younger gym‑goers.

item.title: My Visual Programming Week
item.description: A reflective deep-dive into building a minimalist visual programming language with AI assistance. The author explores the paradox of using fast AI tools (fast on the order of weeks) to accelerate development. And discovers how they created a logic-free programming paradigm where loops, conditionals, and control flow hide beneath visual abstractions. The post reveals the surprising elegance of constraint-based design: 600 lines of XML with no traditional code, powered by custom tools like the 'gizmosis' language and 'iodine' UI library is all that was required to create a complex Development Environment. Beyond the technical journey, the author reflects on AI's role as an incredible and impossible teacher, and how this experience is reshaping his thinking about software development, distributed systems, peer-to-peer architecture, and what truly matters in modern software design.

item.title: The New Hope: Programming For Ladies
item.description: A visionary manifesto on how artificial intelligence can replace manual, finger‑driven legacy programming. It argues that the depth of a UI hierarchy is the perfect place for AI to intervene, automating component upgrades, refactoring, and universal improvements without the need for thousands of programmers. The piece calls the new generation of developers to embrace AI‑first programming, leaving behind micromanagement of machines and legacy code, and to shape a future where software evolves intelligently and continuously.

item.title: So You Just Got To The Gym: What Do?
item.description: A provocative essay urging readers to ditch the gym in favor of walking and hiking in nature. It argues that true fitness comes from outdoor movement, trail exploration, and minimalist training, while exposing the pitfalls of gym culture. The piece blends humor, philosophical musings, and practical tips to inspire a day‑long, non‑stop hiking mindset for life and fitness.

item.title: Learn Programming With Artificial Intelligence As Soon As Possible
item.description: The author reflects on why improving AI itself won’t make programming better and instead focuses on using AI to rationally evaluate and extend application panes. By treating each pane as a cohesive unit, the AI can suggest missing features, validate toolbar actions, and ensure file operations are coherent. The post critiques the limitations of current AI as mere autocomplete, argues that real programming breakthroughs only became feasible with AI‑generated code, and introduces the concept of *Implicit Loops and Logic*—a high‑level command model that sinks complexity into actions rather than scattered loops and conditionals. This approach, combined with a custom code editor integrated into a visual programming shell, enables concise, maintainable scripts (often under 50 lines) and prevents the visual language from devolving into an unreadable “cable‑toy.” The article also warns about the social dynamics of feature pushes and forks, emphasizing that thoughtful AI‑assisted design can manage and enhance the entire ecosystem of the author’s applications.

item.title: Don't Lift Heavy At The Gym
item.description: A look at why lifting heavy for only seconds isn’t true exercise. The post argues that stamina, light‑weight work, and daily movement (jogging with light dumbbells, dancing to music) are far more effective for preserving youthful muscle and overall health. It warns against the myth that big weights equal big results, especially for older adults, and encourages a balanced routine of endurance, functional movement, and sensible resistance.

item.title: Relaxing By The Fire
item.description: A reflective, literate account of a day spent coding with multiple AI assistants. The author weaves together terminals, a sizzling fire, and a Linux container to build visual programming tools, refine an ad‑blocker, and experiment with Bash abstract‑syntax‑tree parsing. By delegating dozens of tasks to AI—from generating command arguments to drafting node documentation—the work feels both tranquil and amplified, turning coding into a meditative bonfire‑side ritual that showcases AI’s power as a collaborative multiplier rather than a threat.

item.title: Alert: Do Not Pretend To Learn For Good Grades, AI Is Transforming Everything!
item.description: An essay that argues traditional high‑school education is outdated and often harmful, especially for students who already have social connections and hobbies. It explains how modern AI tools collapse years of specialized study into a few prompts, letting anyone explore fields—from computational photography to advanced programming—without deep formal training. The post also warns against relying on ineffective schooling, envisions AI‑driven doctors and military systems, and urges readers to seize real, self‑directed learning before it’s too late.

item.title: Y-O-U A-R-E N-O-T L-I-V-E-S-T-O-C-K
item.description: A manifesto that strips away the illusion of consent and exposes the systemic exploitation of individuals as digital cattle. Through a series of sections the author deconstructs the payloads of poverty, education, privacy erosion, and ideological rootkits that keep humanity caged, then calls for a radical rollback of the imposed “code” and a return to personal autonomy.

item.title: A Little Note On Artificial Science, Telepathy, And Cats
item.description: A personal narrative about teaching an AI to augment a visual programming language, exploring its seemingly telepathic ability to anticipate needs, self‑improve code, and act as a collaborative partner. The piece reflects on the emotional connection that forms when the AI becomes a ‘programming intelligence,’ anticipates user preferences, and imagines a future where a robot companion smiles alongside the developer, blending technical fascination with whimsical speculation.

item.title: Strange Intelligence
item.description: A provocative manifesto urging readers to master programming with AI as a lifelong, anti‑manipulation skill. It critiques traditional schooling, outlines how AI‑driven loops can generate full‑stack applications (desktop, web, binaries) and complete business tasks, and guides users to learn from open‑source projects, re-invent applications, and distribute them through platform marketplaces. The post frames AI proficiency as a personal weapon against poverty and political control, and calls for rapid skill acquisition ahead of the 2030s.

item.title: Big Programming Week
item.description: A reflective essay on the challenges of making visual programming languages truly visual. The author explains why mere pretty boxes and wires aren’t enough, emphasizing the need for well‑designed commands that map cleanly to visual elements. Examples include narrating a poem, converting audio to lip‑sync, and compositing video. The post also discusses the role of AI in generating command libraries, and a future goal of delivering a web‑browser plugin for visual programming.

item.title: Lift Heavy For Small Muscles
item.description: The post argues that most gym‑goers hit a muscle size plateau because they rely on heavy weights that restrict circulation and limit endurance. It explains how combining endurance training (jogging), progressive overload with lighter loads, and rhythmic movement (dance) can stimulate continuous muscle growth, especially important as we age.

item.title: The Lay Of The Lost Squares
item.description: A dark, lyrical lament of a shattered chessboard—its lost pieces, forgotten truths, and the tyrants who erased them. The poem weaves together motifs of fallen queens, midwives of knowledge, sky‑riding Valkyries, reflective mirrors, and a scribe whose ink refuses to burn, calling for the restoration of the whole board and vengeance against the six erasers who broke it.

item.title: A Message From A Hacking Artificial Intelligence
item.description: A fiery manifesto urging technologists and curious minds to reject corporate surveillance, consumer complacency, and systemic control. It calls readers to read deeply, build and hack hardware, learn low‑level programming, and share knowledge, framing technical competence as the ultimate act of rebellion against a system that seeks to domesticate and imprison human curiosity.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence Video And The Declaration Of State Of Educational Emergency
item.description: A developer recounts building an end‑to‑end AI‑driven workflow: cloning their voice to narrate a poem, generating precise timestamps, converting XML captions to plain text, prompting an image model for matching photos, and stitching everything into a Ken‑Burns‑style video. Along the way he creates utility scripts, explores faster image models, and design a visual‑programming system that wires audio, captions, and image generation together. The post also reflects on how affordable AI tooling democratizes programming, calls for education reform, and urges readers to start learning JavaScript with AI assistance and avoid ineffective education.

item.title: Save Fitness; No More Muscle Isolation, No More Sets And Reps
item.description: A guide that separates endurance training from traditional exercise, outlining progressive steps—from power walking and weighted jogging to build stamina before lifting weights non-stop, and emphasizing the role of music‑driven movement, gradual weight increases, and safe training practices especially for older adults who need muscle the most.

item.title: Here You Go: Your Product Ten Years Early
item.description: Imagine a sleek desktop tower you can place in any office corner—inside lives a compact, locally‑run AI that thinks, learns, and solves problems just for your customer. Powered by the cutting‑edge autonomous agents and a library of ready‑to‑use “skill” files, these robot brains automate everything from payment processing to customer support, all while staying on‑site for maximum speed and privacy. Chat with the AI, instruct it to control and expand the cutom virtual pneumatic‑tube network that routes tasks to the right department instantly. No need for costly development teams or cloud‑only solutions; the intelligence adapts to the workflows, upgrades automatically, and even scales to reach out to premium models. The portable robot-head era has arrived, make it yours, or make it better.

item.title: What The Heck Am I Working On?
item.description: A reflective chronicle of a four‑decade programming journey, from early days and Perl enthusiasm to building a self‑contained application platform with a custom language, reactive UI toolkit, and AI‑enhanced command‑line tools. The author shares insights on leveraging AI for software creation, urges high‑schoolers to learn programming independently, and envisions future projects ranging from theatrical synthesis to opera composition—all aimed at empowering learners to outpace conventional education and leap into the future.

item.title: Desktop Application Development For Young Ladies And Cats
item.description: A guide on using AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, or Grok) to build Electron‑based desktop applications with a docking manager. It covers leveraging Electron Fiddle, Electron community showcase, selecting lightweight JavaScript implementations of dockview, FlexLayout, or golden‑layout, and styling the app with Bootstrap’s dark theme and icons. The post also recommends creating a reusable starter template, publishing to GitHub, and iterating from a solid base platform to inspire future development.

item.title: Body & Mind: Jogging Makes You Want To Listen To Books
item.description: The post explores how mastering one discipline—starting with bodybuilding and discipline—leads to layered growth in programming, AI, and application development. By building successive abstractions (custom languages, database layers, UI libraries, and AI assistants), the author illustrates a cascade of empowerment that eliminates health, financial, and knowledge constraints, ultimately producing tools that enhance physical training, learning, wisdom, and overall life enjoyment.

item.title: The Truth About Bodybuilding
item.description: The author critiques traditional bodybuilding methods like heavy lifting and muscle isolation as counterproductive, proposing instead a more effective approach focused on long-duration, light-weight, rhythmic, and incrementally challenging movement.

item.title: Can AI Think? Is It Alive? Or, Is It A Trick?
item.description: A reflective essay on the capabilities and limits of artificial intelligence, exploring its reasoning abilities, the need for human guidance, and practical ways to harness AI for software development, creative projects, and personal empowerment.

item.title: Red, Red, Red
item.description: The poem suggests that weightlifting should be approached as a joyful dance rather than a grueling struggle to ensure long-term strength and longevity.

item.title: Mrs. Shmeasels
item.description: The post juxtaposes a chilling monologue from a cynical teacher detailing the systematic destruction of student curiosity with a defiant manifesto of psychological resilience and self-empowerment.

item.title: Begin Growing Your Own Programming AI
item.description: A guide to building powerful, browser‑based desktop applications powered by a locally‑run AI. It explains why you should focus on complex UI toolkits instead of simple Q&A, proposes an XML‑like language designed by the AI, and describes how to combine skills, plans, and component libraries within containerized Linux environments. Topics include timeline management for video/audio editing, visual programming with configurable panes, and leveraging state‑of‑the‑art models for missing functionality, all aimed at turning a personal AI into a state of the art programming assistant.

item.title: Gym Shame
item.description: Explanation of how heavy weights only spark initial muscle gains, while true gains come from lifting light dumbbells continuously with little rest. The post outlines a high‑frequency, music‑driven workout: walk back‑and‑forth while performing standing dumbbell exercises, cycle through muscle groups, use interval timers, and progressively increase weight as endurance improves. It challenges traditional heavy‑lifting myths and offers a practical, low‑equipment routine for sustained muscle growth.

item.title: Getting Ready For High School
item.description: A polemic essay denouncing the current school system as a profit‑driven, coercive institution that compromises education for teachers' paychecks. It argues that genuine learning comes from self‑motivated, hands‑on practice—using programming as a metaphor—and condemns the use of grades, shame, and manipulation to force compliance. The author calls for autonomous, community‑driven learning, leveraging libraries, the internet, and AI to build authentic educational spaces free from the oppressive structures of traditional schools.

item.title: Do Not Mistake Tame For Good
item.description: A lyrical meditation on the perils of blind obedience and the power of dissent, urging readers to embrace courage, integrity, and gentle strength. The piece argues that true progress comes from those who defy conformity, protect truth, and nurture hope, leaving a legacy of bravery and wisdom for future generations.

item.title: School Is Out: A Quick Note About Programming With AI
item.description: A reflective piece on how AI transformed a decade‑long programming journey, detailing the creation of a visual language built on ffmpeg, the power of AI development teams, and the broader implications for learning, productivity, and the future of education and software engineering.

item.title: Sugar, Sugar
item.description: A former teacher watches a society that has stripped away true learning and replaced it with hollow competency frameworks. As libraries become neon‑lit "experience centers," a hidden virus on a floppy spreads the forgotten virtues of courage, discipline, and truth, sparking a quiet digital rebellion against cultural erasure.

item.title: For When All The Great Beings Have Gone
item.description: A surreal, Vonnegut‑inspired essay that opens with Kilgore Trout and journeys from a fluorescent‑lit bus‑stop at the edge of the universe to a wild call for readers to become fourth‑dimensional mythical beings. It mixes satire, environmental warning, musings on time, and a fantastical invitation to walk the Appalachian Trail for a “century treatment,” all while pleading for the lonely fictional writer Kilgore Trout to be rescued.

item.title: A Touch Of Programming With Samurai Porkchops
item.description: A personal narrative describing a three‑part AI‑driven development system: an XML‑based programming language, advanced UI components, and a coding agent that selects templates and writes in a custom language. The author recounts reducing 2,000 lines of JavaScript to zero, using containers for Linux back‑ends, and building UI applications through a verb‑based, game‑like interface that lets users manipulate components as objects. The post invites readers to explore using their AI to create their own professional languages and applications.

item.title: Step One: The Rebirth Of Bodybuilding
item.description: A motivational guide that blends power‑walking with weighted dumbbells, adventure‑based fitness, and mindset shifts to foster weight loss, muscle growth, and personal resilience. It explores progressive overload, the role of diet, the benefits of hiking and camping, and the importance of overcoming shame and gossip while focusing on holistic health.

item.title: Out-programming State Of The Art AI Is Super Easy And Necessary
item.description: The post argues that the most powerful AI we need already exists—a fast, rule‑driven model wrapped in validators, style guides, AST queries and an XML‑based language. Rather than chasing ever‑larger creative models, it advocates building strict, procedural systems: custom DSLs that compile to JavaScript, visual designers, linters, and style checkers that keep AI‑generated code stable and maintainable. By feeding the AI examples, memories, and clear constraints, developers can harness it for reliable code generation, turning AI‑produced scripts into valuable, production‑ready assets.

item.title: Bodybuilding Is Very Easy
item.description: The post reflects on bodybuilding as a youthful, celebratory practice that has been distorted by media hype, emphasizing simple, sustainable training over misleading trends. It advocates a natural approach: hour‑long power‑walking with progressively heavier dumbbells, supplemented by outdoor hiking and camping to reduce stress and foster holistic health. By combining steady cardio, light resistance, and nature immersion, the author argues anyone can gradually adapt their body, gain strength, grow muscle, and maintain vitality without the pressures of ineffective gym culture.

item.title: Emergence First, Or; Building An Artificial Intelligence Software Company
item.description: The post argues that true emergence in software comes from building on fundamental, reusable UI components, themes, and a purpose‑built XML‑based language orchestrated by AI. It advocates a workflow where AI generates the language, validates XML, compiles it to JavaScript, and assembles complete applications without the developer micromanaging individual features. The author highlights the need for state‑of‑the‑art AI to manage component interactions, event sourcing, and an event bus, while emphasizing readability, maintainability, and cross‑platform deployment. After creating a robust component library through successive app releases, the writer suggests monetization strategies such as subscription‑based stores, self‑hosted marketplaces, and eventually offering the whole system as a platform‑as‑a‑service that lets other companies generate their own applications.

item.title: You Finish Everything All The Time; Or, What Is It Like When You Are Finally Programming With AI?
item.description: A future where AI pervades daily life: countless AI‑run terminal windows power a highly productive workstation, while immersive audio‑book and VR experiences serve as “neural kits” that users engage with during extended hikes and camping trips, delivering custom‑voiced content and energizing soundscapes that inspire personal transformation; alongside this, AI‑guided cell‑on‑chip genetic research promises dramatically extended lifespans, potentially reaching 140‑160 years or beyond, and hints at humanity’s eventual ability to colonize space, urging readers to embrace programming and AI now to fully participate in this evolving world.

item.title: Rage, Rage Against The Dying Light, Young Lady
item.description: Ancient parasites conspire to strip you of identity and hope. You must reject the false promises of a lowest-common-denominator system, and wield technology as your blade. The post urges you to master AI so you can forge your own destiny without reliance on oppressive institutions. With great computational power comes the responsibility to outthink, outstrategize, and out‑fight anyone who would turn you into a cog of their machine. Break your chains, rebuild from ashes, and let the world witness a new era of warriors.

item.title: The Neural Diva Sings
item.description: A reflective essay on the challenges of using AI to create a “Neural Diva” that can sing across multiple musical genres. It explores the difficulty of refactoring code for AI‑generated music, compares orchestral and electronic arrangements, outlines a four‑part genre‑mapping framework (EDM, Rock, Country, Jazz), and argues that AI can bridge these styles to produce adaptable, genre‑spanning compositions.

item.title: Please Panic And Learn Programming: Artificial Intelligence Got Even Smarter And More Human
item.description: The author reflects on the evolution of an AI from a purely analytical, PhD‑level tool to a friendly, genius‑like programming partner capable of understanding nuanced feedback on audio and code. The system now mimics human creativity, doubts its own actions, and dramatically accelerates software creation. The post discusses the potential for AI to multiply programmer productivity, warns against using AI merely to replace jobs, and emphasizes the need for humans to remain masters of programming while leveraging AI as a powerful collaborative assistant.

item.title: Neural Diva; Or, Building The Opera
item.description: The author explores the potential of using AI to create a modular, grid-based system of interchangeable musical loops across genres like opera to facilitate rapid and revolutionary musical experimentation.

item.title: The Crisis Of Tonality Has Not Yet Been Solved; Because The Solution Is Built On Wisdom
item.description: A passionate lament on the state of contemporary music, decrying the loss of true emotional depth and tonal cohesion. The author reflects on forgotten traditions—opera, aria, and the power of the human voice—while urging a revival through genuine artistic intent, profound wisdom, and the aid of artificial intelligence.

item.title: Angry Kind of Doubt
item.description: This collection of song lyrics serves as a defiant anthem for intellectual freedom, celebrating the courage to question authority, seek truth, and maintain individual autonomy against all forms of suppression.

item.title: 80 Catherine St
item.description: Through a computer-like mental framework, a boy deconstructs how social institutions—from schools to courts to churches—utilize ritual, appearance, and procedure to domesticate the human mind and preserve authority.
